about: Waiting for the bucket lets an hour pass, and the bucket comes down while Marta waits; Wren, in the same well, reads it come too, and the line's next command runs once the time has passed.

steps.type: hoist bucket. wait for bucket. look

expect.words: You haul on the rope, and the bucket rises out of sight.
You settle down to wait for the bucket.

expect.text: well_bottom.bucket woke, 1200 seconds after it asked

expect.words: The bucket comes back down the well, swinging.
The bucket comes back down the well, swinging.
The bottom of a dry well. A rope runs up out of sight.
